title: Compatibility system for the specified polynomial Koszul diagonal classes
statement: Use the localized charts, graph-normalized isomorphisms κ, their adjunct classes ξ, scalar changes and refinements of [def-sfb-polynomial-koszul-diagonal-data]. For commutative R and B with an R-algebra structure, a diagonal datum assigns a graph-normalized κ_P to every localized polynomial chart P→B and requires multiplication by ξ_P to be an isomorphism B[0]→RHom_{B⊗_R B}(B,C_1), using [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. A diagonal assignment assigns such a datum for every Noetherian commutative R and flat finitely presented R-algebra B [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Define its compatibility-system predicate to mean: (i) every admissible scalar-extension or simultaneous-localization chart change between such algebras admits the evaluation-counit-normalized coinduction comparison and this comparison carries the specified ξ to the target ξ through the canonical diagonal and first-pullback comparisons; (ii) identity comparisons equal the canonical identity scalar-extension identification; (iii) successive comparisons equal the comparison for the composite, under the canonical derived scalar-extension composition identification; (iv) every one-variable evaluation refinement preserves the specified class and its map is independent of the lift as in the data definition; (v) all ordered iterated refinement maps between the same charts agree; (vi) the refinement square commutes with admissible scalar extension and localization. The identity and composition scalar-extension identifications are defined using uniqueness of left adjoints to the actual restriction-of-scalars functors, with their existing evaluation-normalized scalar-extension adjunctions. These are definitions of data and a predicate on that data; no existence of a compatible assignment is assumed or asserted here.

reviewed_lean.note: F1 (H3, sign): IsKoszulDiagonalRefinement.IsContraction pins the contraction by Mathlib's ShortExact.singleδ. Its mapping-cone triangle has mor₃ = −fst (inl_v_triangle_mor₃_f), so it is the negative roof, while IsKoszulDiagonalGraphTrace uses the positive Koszul cocycle (top wedge ↦ volume; project koszulComplex d(e)=+f matches the cone differential +φ). The refinement clause is then false: with n=0, R=B=P=ℤ, Q=ℤ[t], t↦0, the model map sends ξ_Q to −ξ_P; a chain-level lift through K(x,t) gives the same −1 for every n. FIX: fixes/PolynomialKoszulDiagonalData.lean uses (-hs.singleδ)⟦n⟧' with a convention docstring; fixes/def-sfb-polynomial-koszul-diagonal-data.json rewrites only the statement sentence on the contraction (Koszul evaluation dual(t-a)⊗d(t-a)↦1, minus the cone connecting morphism). No recorded lean.statement changes. Other checks pass: β, τ and κ are uniquely pinned by their counit and cocycle equations, so the ∃-assignment is not hollow; ξ is the adjunct of κ⁻¹; no extra hypotheses (Noetherian R, flat finitely presented B, no flatness of R→R'); scalar, localization, identity and composition changes, lift independence and ordered iterates are rendered; edge cases n=0, B=0, h=1, h=0, R=0 covered; statement verbatim; source and blueprint docstrings present; only the item theorem is sorry; no duplicate notion found. Advisory: multiplication by ξ uses the helper's closed internal Hom rather than the recorded derived internal Hom; IsIso does not depend on that choice.
